meta.empirical_sigma_note: MEASURED: robust std (1.4826*MAD) of leave-one-out relative residuals Q/Qhat-1 about a local-in-time rating curve (poly deg 2-3 of logQ on stage, fitted to non-ice gaugings within +/-5.0 yr, >= 15 neighbors, no stage extrapolation). Includes rating shift and hysteresis within the window, so it is an UPPER BOUND on pure measurement error.
meta.flow_bands: per-site terciles of in-window measured discharge
meta.rating_map_note: USGS convention: Excellent ~2%, Good ~5%, Fair ~8%, Poor >8%; we use 0.12 for Poor. 'Unspecified' excluded. Per-band value is the RMS of mapped sigmas.
